body.statement: The constructed law \(P^{\star}\) belongs to \(\mathcal P_4^{\circ}\), and at \(P=P^{\star}\) it satisfies \(E_P|D(O)|^{5/2}<\infty\) and \(E_P|D(O)|^3=\infty\).
body.justification: The witness shows that the weak-moment argument is structural rather than cosmetic and rules out proofs that silently invoke a third moment.
body.gap: The positive-censoring frameworks of Westling et al. (2024) and Díaz et al. (2019) exclude this endpoint behavior by construction.
body.consumer: It gives referees and software authors a concrete stress test for variance and Studentization implementations.
